{{Quote|I was under the impression that Darth Maul's home world was Iridonia.''"<br />"''Dathomir is the planet where Maul was raised. Iridonia is where the rest of the males of the species dwell.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Mace Windu|<ref name="Witches of the Mist">{{TCW|Witches of the Mist}}</ref>}}
'''Iridonia''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] species. Due to the harsh living conditions, the Zabrak were a hardy species. They took to flight and then space travel as soon as they could develop the technology, and by the time the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] encountered them, they had already colonized five systems. Notable Iridonians included [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], [[Bao-Dur]], [[Drell Kahmf]], [[Sirak]], and [[Maris Brood]].

==History==
===Wars of the Sith and Mandalorians===
[[File:iridonian_city.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Malidris|capital city]] of Iridonia.]]
As a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated near important [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] lanes, Iridonia was one of the key worlds that connected the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. As such, it was often one of the first planets to be pulled into a war.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

When Iridonia increased taxes on imported technology from [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], Duro's officials banned their shipments to Iridonia in retaliation for the tariffs. The Zabrak leaders did not want their populace to know that they would make a deal with the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] government, so an under-the-table negotiation was planned at a neutral location: [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] over the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] representative, [[Belai Kaleeg]], was shot, but survived, and his assailant was killed. When he later met with the Iridonian representative, [[Koon Odan]], and was looking over the treaty documents, the documents went blank and Odan tried to run away. It was revealed that the Iridonian government had sent an assassin to kill Kaleeg to stop the treaty. After the plot was revealed, the documents were restored and the Iridonia government denied all involvement.<ref name="GoI">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>

{{RPG|''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''}}
If Odan was killed after the treaty documents went blank, the treaty between Iridonia and Duros was canceled. The disagreements escalated, and a small-scale war between the two planets broke out, and had to be settled by outside entities.<ref name="GoI" />
{{Endgame}}

During the [[Old Sith Wars]], the planet was the site of numerous battles. A [[First Battle of Iridonia|battle]] at Iridonia, fought during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], was a major victory for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was a turning point in the war which gave the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] momentum which would help them to eventually defeat their Sith adversaries.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

Several of Iridonia's colonies along the Outer Rim were [[Attacks on the Zabrak colonies|conquered]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the initial stages of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. After learning of the loss of their colonies, many Iridonians, including [[Bao-Dur]], sought revenge by joining the Republic's war effort against the Mandalorian invaders. In the same year, [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] launched a major offensive against Iridonia. After a successful campaign, they occupied the planet for a number of months until Iridonia was eventually [[Second battle of Iridonia (Mandalorian Wars)|liberated]] by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /><ref name="Iridonian Darkness">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/iridonian|text=Iridonian Darkness|int=Iridonian Darkness}}</ref>

Iridonia changed hands a number of times during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] and the Republic fought fiercely over the planet, and both sides used it as a staging ground during the conflict. Due to the fact that Iridonia was occupied by the Sith at times, the eight Iridonian colonies became self sufficient. Following the war, they broke away and became independent worlds.<ref name="KOTORCG" /><ref name="Iridonian Darkness" />

Around [[1002 BBY]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] operated a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] academy on the world that trained [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]]. The Sith also hired Zabrak mercenaries from the planet's high council.<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

===Post-Ruusan history===
{{Quote|Didn't realize the Clone War had reached Iridonia.|[[Nukss]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters">''[[The Clone Wars: The Sith Hunters]]''</ref>}}
After the [[Ruusan campaign]], the Zabrak established colonies on many far-flung worlds. The Zabrak of Iridonia maintained the most militant culture, and Zabrak youths from the colonies were often sent to the original homeworld for warrior training.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Iridonia and its colonies remained loyal to the Republic. Several months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and after the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] tried to cause political upheaval and insurrections in the colonies, one of Iridonia's eight colonies petitioned to secede from the Republic. This caused "The Great Debate," but ended with Iridonia and all of its colonies continued support of the Republic.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

===The New Republic and beyond===
[[Kaysil Verwood]] became the first [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of her people, representing not only Iridonia but all the Zabrak colonies. The Zabrak were founding members of the government, as Verwood attended the Galactic Caucus to form the new government.

[[File:Zabrak_representatives.jpg|thumb|200px|Two representatives of the Zabrak government meet with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].]]
At some point after the formation of the New Republic, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited the world as an ambassador to help with opening new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. While staying on the planet, he encountered a [[solid-state hologram]] said to be the ghost of the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. The ghostly image had terrified the Zabrak government for some time, driving one council representative to the brink of madness. Skywalker tracked the apparition down to a [[Laboratory of Drell Kahmf|laboratory]] run by the Zabrak scientist [[Drell Kahmf]], who claimed to have salvaged the brain of Maul and constructed the hologram body for it to wreak havoc on society.<ref name="TCSWE2">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The Jedi was appalled at the torment of the disembodied man, and disconnected the device keeping the brain alive.<ref name="T17PM" />

When [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] was first established, Iridonia was among the first worlds to pledge its allegiance to the new [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Since Zabraks were traditionally a species that produced many [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], Iridonia contributed more apprentices to the [[One Sith]] than any other world. However, despite the wishes of Iridonian government, several Zabrak colonies rebelled against the new Empire. Two such colonies were completely wiped out when [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyers]] issued [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] to reduce their [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to rubble. After the punishment the remaining five colonies surrendered to Imperial forces and one of them, [[Feldrona]], was transformed into a prison planet and placed under tight Imperial control.<ref name="LECG" />
